indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_reviews_order ON public.order_reviews USING btree (order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX order_reviews_pkey ON public.order_reviews USING btree (review_id, order_id)
readOnlySql:
WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_reviews GROUP BY order_id), per_state AS (
 SELECT c.customer_state AS state,COUNT(*) AS review_records,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
 FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id
 WHERE r.review_score<=2 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT json_build_object('reviewRows',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews),'reviewedOrders',(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_reviews),
 'lowReviewRows',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score<=2),'lowReviewedOrders',(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score<=2),
 'maxReviewsPerOrder',(SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM per_order),'ordersWithMultipleReviews',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE cnt>1),
 'perState',(SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(s) ORDER BY state) FROM per_state s),
 'indexes',(SELECT json_agg(indexdef ORDER BY indexname) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='order_reviews'),
 'examples',(SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(e)) FROM (SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) AS review_count,array_agg(review_score ORDER BY review_score) AS scores
 FROM order_reviews GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,order_id LIMIT 4)e))
